neighbours.label: a descriptive quality adjective that characterizes how something is done or how someone is (organized, professional, fashionable, anxious), especially the second adjective of an 'X and Y' pair; classifying uses ('a professional photographer') and sentences without such an adjective stay low
fire: Our technicians are punctual and professional, and they always clean up after the job.
The documents were kept in a tidy and organized filing cabinet in the back office.
She looked chic and fashionable in a long wool coat at the premiere.
After the long interview he felt nervous and tense for the rest of the afternoon.
The hotel staff were warm, attentive and courteous throughout our stay.
We pride ourselves on delivering honest and dependable advice to every client.
The new manager runs the warehouse in a calm and orderly way.
The volunteers felt proud and honored to carry the flag in the parade.
quiet: Our technicians arrive at nine, and they always clean up after the job.
The documents were kept in a filing cabinet in the back office.
She wore a long wool coat to the premiere on Friday night.
After the long interview he went home for the rest of the afternoon.
The hotel staff carried our bags upstairs throughout our stay.
We send a written report to every client within two weeks.
The new manager runs the warehouse from a small office upstairs.
The volunteers carried the flag in the parade down Main Street.

short: quality adjective, esp. in 'X and Y'
notes: Card: top 32 peak on ' professional' x8, ' fashionable', ' organized', ' honored', ' tense' - mostly the second adjective after 'and'. Probe: 'stored in an organized manner' 1.126, 'reliable and professional plumbing' 0.824, 'courteous and professional' 0.692, 'elegant and fashionable' 0.627, 'tired and anxious' 0.524; classifying 'a professional photographer' 0.137, no-adjective 'provides cleaning services' 0.035.
